title: Friday evening tenders expire on Saturday
text: Routing is auto-expiring weekend tenders before carriers ever see them, and a couple of carriers on the Hartline Midwest lanes have complained. A tender offered to a Chicago carrier on Friday 2026-04-10 at 18:00 CDT shows an expiry of Saturday 09:00, when their office is closed; it should run to Monday 09:00 CDT. Tenders offered Monday through Thursday look right. The expiry comes from `tender_expires_at` in `tender_expiry.py`.
